issue.title: etcdctl 2.2.3 updatedir fails without extraneous argument.

repository.name: etcd
repository.description: Distributed reliable key-value store for the most critical data of a distributed system

issue.body:
As of 2.2, etcdctl updatedir seems to want another argument, but it doesnt do anything with it.

To reproduce:
   etcdctl setdir /foo -ttl 60
   etcdctl  updatedir /foo -ttl 90 
   <ctrl-d>
Error:  value required

If at an interactive console, this will wait on stdin for the value, ctrl-d will end that and cause the failure. If in a non-interactive context, it will fail immediately with the message.

Im not very famliar with the etcd code, but it seems like these 4 lines at the end of the pasted code fragment below should be removed.

func updatedirCommandFunc(c *cli.Context, ki client.KeysAPI) {
    if len(c.Args()) == 0 {
        handleError(ExitBadArgs, errors.New("key required"))
    }
    key := c.Args()[0]
    value, err := argOrStdin(c.Args(), os.Stdin, 1)
    if err != nil {
        handleError(ExitBadArgs, errors.New("value required"))
    }

...

issue.title: etcdctl: ignore value in updatedir command

repository.name: etcd
repository.description: Distributed reliable key-value store for the most critical data of a distributed system

issue.body:
Fixes https://github.com/coreos/etcd/issues/4145.
client.KeysAPI ignores value if SetOptions.Dir is true.
